required_environment: preprovisioned pytest and jsonschema test extras
forbidden_effects: package installation or download beyond the user's one-time authorization for the declared test extras
Faraday runtime live model, connector, instrument, or network calls
real study data or canonical workspace edits by hand
permission, deployment, or remote Git changes by a worker

jobs.title: Characterize the existing synthetic journey
jobs.deliverable: A synthetic two-group CSV, inquiry and plan fixture, expected artifacts, and an inventory of existing service and CLI routes
jobs.required_adverse_case: An existing validation failure remains a failure in the characterization
jobs.completion_evidence: Fixture identity, exact baseline command result, and no production behavior change

jobs.title: Expose a read-only guide context and proposal contract
jobs.deliverable: Versioned context over existing inquiry state and hash-bound, review-only guide proposals; no provider call
jobs.required_adverse_case: Changed context hash, unknown reference, or proposal claiming approval is rejected
jobs.completion_evidence: Schema and service round-trip with no canonical write from context or proposal validation

jobs.title: Guide question intake and clarification
jobs.deliverable: A reviewable intake preview preserving original wording and unresolved population, unit, outcome, comparison, timing, decision, data, and ethics fields
jobs.required_adverse_case: An absent answer stays unknown and cannot be filled with a generated assertion
jobs.completion_evidence: Preview-to-existing-command mapping and recorded original statement

jobs.title: Draft competing explanations
jobs.deliverable: Review-only null, measurement-error, selection/confounding, and user-favored model candidates with predictions and falsifiers
jobs.required_adverse_case: An AI candidate cannot activate itself or omit every meaningful alternative
jobs.completion_evidence: Existing hypothesis service receives only explicitly routed unreviewed proposals

jobs.title: Preview a supported prospective design
jobs.deliverable: A design preview binding unit, measurement, timing, signed contrast, estimand, missingness, multiplicity, stopping rule, uncertainty target, and supported method
jobs.required_adverse_case: Wrong scale, unit, timing, contrast, or unsupported design fails before outcome inspection
jobs.completion_evidence: Existing design and protocol validators remain the deciding authority

jobs.title: Organize CSV data through custody
jobs.deliverable: Raw-byte-preserving inventory of typed columns, units, missingness, invalid values, source route, role, lineage, and readiness gaps
jobs.required_adverse_case: Changed bytes, duplicate unit IDs, invalid codes, or missing custody cannot be presented as ready evidence
jobs.completion_evidence: Registration, if applicable, uses existing dataset service and retains input hashes

jobs.title: Execute and explain supported statistics
jobs.deliverable: Pinned existing-method execution for independent, paired, and observational two-group fixtures, each with effect, interval, exclusions, diagnostics, assumptions, limitations, and write-once receipt
jobs.required_adverse_case: Paired-as-independent, post-result method switch, incompatible scale, or altered receipt is rejected
jobs.completion_evidence: Result and receipt bind exact plan, dataset, method implementation, and output bytes

jobs.title: Interpret and iterate without claim promotion
jobs.deliverable: Deterministic synthesis plus a versioned, prerequisite-checked next experiment proposal
jobs.required_adverse_case: Negative, conflicting, and inconclusive results remain visible and cannot become confirmation
jobs.completion_evidence: Report shows alternatives, uncertainty, conclusion ceiling, and reasons when no next test is eligible

jobs.title: Stub external and domain-specific capabilities
jobs.deliverable: Typed not_configured or unsupported responses and a TODO register for live models, connectors, instruments, arbitrary methods, reviewer identity, Metamaps, and concurrency
jobs.required_adverse_case: No unavailable capability performs an effect, claims a fallback, or grants authority
jobs.completion_evidence: Every TODO names owner, missing contract/evidence, first safe fixture, and activation gate

jobs.title: Automate end-to-end fixture acceptance
jobs.deliverable: One-command local checker, full synthetic journey, adverse matrix, audit and ledger verification, and user-facing limits
jobs.required_adverse_case: Any missing check, drifted artifact, unauthorized transition, or report overclaim exits nonzero
jobs.completion_evidence: Exact-commit JSON receipt with all checks passed and software_fixture_ready true
